response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS average_loss_rate FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY team_id) AS team_rates;

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id across all years; each qualifying manager_half record contributes equally to its team's average, and each team contributes equally to the final average.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each team in each year as a separate team-season.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(team_avg) AS average_loss_rate FROM (SELECT year, team_id, AVG(CAST(l AS REAL) / g) AS team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 GROUP BY year, team_id) AS team_rates;
